region_copy.team_heading: Keeping Chicagoland drivers on the road
region_copy.team_body: Our team at Jiffy Lube is here to make routine maintenance fast, easy, and worry-free for drivers in the Chicago area. Our certified technicians handle everything from oil changes and tire rotations to multi-point inspections, so you don’t have to think twice about it. We know your time matters — that’s why we focus on quick, honest service you can trust, with no surprises and no upselling you don’t need. Stop by your nearest Chicagoland Jiffy Lube and see why your neighbors keep coming back. Jiffy Does It.

popular_times._note: PLACEHOLDER. Google does not provide popular-times data through its API. Values are relative busyness 0-100 for each hour 7am-8pm, per weekday starting Sunday. Replace with real data or set enabled to false to hide the section.

analytics._note: Paste a Google Analytics 4 measurement ID like G-XXXXXXXXXX to enable tracking, or leave empty.

google_ads_conversions._note: Google Ads conversion labels (from Min, 2026-10-06). Each fires alongside the GA4 event of the same name.

analytics._vercel_note: Vercel Web Analytics: set vercel_analytics to false to remove the script. Also needs Analytics enabled in the Vercel project dashboard.

wallet._note: Set enabled to true once the Apple and Google Wallet accounts are configured in Vercel. apple/google can be toggled separately.

attribution._note: Visitors arriving with ?jl=<key> (checked first) or ?utm_term=<key> see the coupon code mapped to that key, on every page for 30 days. Keys not in the table fall back to offer.code. Add one line per campaign; make sure the stores accept each code.
